$comment: First-run content of a fresh Zumi board, fed to Laneboard's scripts/seed.mjs (every record goes through POST /api/v1/write as the owner). One sample task with one open question on its waiting step; nobody's real board is copied.

data.title: Sample task: how to use the board
data.now: Look at the steps below: each step has one state; the current step is computed by the server
data.context:
This board runs right on your machine (127.0.0.1): no network, no sign-in. Its core is Laneboard: every change goes through a single write gate and is journaled.
- Each step has exactly one of 5 states: Done · Doing · Waiting · Blocked · Todo.
- A Waiting step may not sit before a Done step: that question was already overtaken by new work. The server refuses the whole write and lists each violation.
- The current step is computed by the server: the first Doing step; if none, the Waiting step, then Blocked, then Todo.
- A task with a Doing step that has not been updated for 12 hours shows the "stale 12h" label.
This sample task uses all 5 states.

steps.detail: The "Current step" line at the top of the task is computed by the server; the page only displays it.

steps.label: A question waiting for your call
steps.detail: The Waiting state is for an open question. Mark the step after it as Done while this one is still Waiting and the server refuses.

steps.label: A step that is blocked
steps.detail: Blocked means something outside is in the way; clear it before continuing.
